notes.title: Community Security & Safety Announcement
notes.notes:
Mercenaries!

We have banned many users who violated the Code of Conduct and EULA.

We have also found that there are users using unauthorized third-party programs which are also against our EULA.

In particular, this week, we strengthened the system monitoring to verify unhealthy users and detected and banned more than 200 accounts for hardware forgery and illegal third-party program use.

Please make sure not to use suspicious programs which may jeopardize your account status.

Also, note that we recommend you secure your account to avoid any unfortunate sanctions.

In addition, we have a number of observation records that record abnormal methods of game play (e.g. abnormal KDA, SD).
Please note that strong measures will be taken against the users who abuse the system.

We will continuously update the anti-cheat, to catch cheaters and we promise to keep the community safe.

You may also report cheaters via 'Hack report' in-game which makes it easier for the system to detect.

Lastly, we are preparing a way to disclose the cheating users in the future so please stay tuned!

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your A.V.A Global Operation Team

P.S. Incredibly, some violators sent a message regarding their account to claim innocence. Please be aware that our team is aware of the violator's negative conduct, so claiming innocence will not work because we have 0 tolerance for violations.

notes.title: A.V.A Global System Changes: ARENA, Capsule
notes.notes:
Mercenaries!

To improve AVA Global, we have been working diligently to bring you new and exciting content. We have also improved the Arena system! 

We hope to continue to bring you a fun gameplay experience. 

This update will make changes based on community feedback. 

[b]1. ARENA Mode Requirement [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/e38d3561dde69f8ab3651423c56f165c9066dd93.jpg[/img]
Previously, we have already announced new game modes in the 2022 timeline. We have added: Arena, Escape, and Sr. Annihilation game modes to bring you excitement! After the update, we have received a lot of suggestions regarding the Arena Mode. 

Since the start of Arena Mode season 1, we have been listening to community suggestions. So, we have taken action by increasing the requirement for this wonderful game mode. The new requirement is Staff Sargent 1 (Level 11). This requirement will take effect after the update. 

The recent anti-cheat improvements have made significant improvements to community safety. 
We have made better ways to deal with those who violate the Code of Conduct by tampering with our community's beloved game: AVA Global.
 We have banned many users from playing for conducting unauthorized activities. 
Please check the full announcement in the [url=https://www.avaonline.global/?mKey=1&sKey=1&bserial=888&ano=42513514#board/read/888/N/42513514/41/888]link[/url]:


[b]2. New Items![/b]
To bring all mercenaries with skins they enjoy, we have added new skinned items to use on all your favorite game modes and maps!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/ebf2195210a82954b6c0f913c05d23f161bffff3.jpg[/img]
Additionally, we have reduced the requirement to obtain capsule items. This means there is no level requirement. Now, new mercenaries can obtain beautiful skinned items to enjoy! 

Further, we are aware that mercenaries really care about gunplay. We will continue to improve and balance various aspects of it. We hope all mercenaries understand that this may take a couple of updates to achieve. We will continue to listen and honor your suggestions and feedback!

See you all in-game! 

Thank you all for your support!

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operations Team

notes.title: ARENA MODE IS READY!
notes.notes:
Mercenaries!

Arena Mode is a new game mode that will be added to 'A.V.A Global' in the upcoming October update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d14c9108200b2891e35d6c19a227c771effe1bc2.png[/img]
As the arena mode will be opened for the first time through this update, the arena season will be held in the form of 'BETA SEASON' for the first & second seasons.

Arena mode is a high concentrating intense mode that is quite different than any other mode. And this mode is focused on the users' skills.
[u]We have to state that everything we are sharing today along with any mentioned timelines may be subject to change.[/u]

[b]ARENA Season Date:[/b]
ARENA BETA SEASON 1: 14th Oct. 2022 00: 00(UTC) ~ 4th Nov. 2022 00: 00(UTC)
ARENA BETA SEASON 2: 11th Nov. 2022 00: 00(UTC) ~ 2nd Dec. 2022 00: 00(UTC)

[b]ARENA RULE:[/b]
The seasons are short however, it will not affect the Arena rewards users will receive.

First of all, until the official Season, users with the rank of 'Staff Sergeant lvl 1' or higher can participate.
[u]*Don't worry. We will hold an experience boost event for users who have not yet achieved the class.[/u]

The Arena Match will be held with 10 participants in a 5v5 match. The team that has 7 Wins out of 13 Rounds wins the game.

In Arena mode, you must participate more carefully since friendly fire is applied.

Finally, the Arena Match is a team match that can accommodate up to 10 players, so if you escape from a game that has already started playing, your ranking points will be deducted immediately.
Therefore, users who participate in the match hope to fight together until the end of the match to win and achieve a higher rank.

[b]ARENA Ranking:[/b]
Arena season rankings can earn ranking points according to users' play, and if you win an arena match, you can earn ranking points, and if you lose, ranking points will be deducted.
However, as we are hosting the beta season for the first time, we will set a "novice safety section" for users
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/8e1f7c042cedc1ce98bf65d5fdfdfea03afbb9b6.png[/img]
*You can check the ARENA RANKING from the 'RANKING' ICON.

So users with 1400 points or less, the ranking points will not be deducted even if they lose the game.
* Users with 1401 points or higher will be deducted from their RP in case of defeat, but will not be lower than 1401 points.

At the start of the Arena season, all users have 1200 base ranking points, and if they have not participated in ARENA for 10 days at the time of the last change in RP,
5 points per day are deducted up to 1200 points of RP, and users with an RP of 1500 or less are not deducted.

[b]ARENA Map:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d93eb97a7aee1f69493cf4793a4d6cc648a1aa5e.png[/img]

[b]Arena Rewards:[/b]
As we mentioned in the last post, we plan to provide this arena reward in as many forms as possible.
As long as you participate in ARENA BETA Season 1, users can receive a 'Unique Soldier Box' as an Arena Mode participation reward.
*If you participate the ARENA MODE 50 matches, you will get one Unique Soldier Box.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/37566c7599b64e625ff46af82dee9807530dc3be.png[/img]

In addition, users who rank 1st to 100th in the season will receive[b] Arena Season Limited 'HG21C Sand' Skin[/b] Reward.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/cc5a22337d9d6e056c9153c53d7f1f9aa3df0f8a.png[/img]
Arena Personal Rating Rewards can be received on a rank point basis that you earn every season, and if you earn a higher tier, you can receive a better reward.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/54d694aed8f24ad2240a055e0dc3a4b487dc0607.jpg[/img]
Arena mode is a new mode being added, if you take your time and play this mode, you will definitely have fun playing it!

We will continue to add additional features in Arena Mode through future updates.

Please enjoy it!

Sincerely,

Your AVA Global Operations Team

notes.title: Anti-Cheat Dev Letter
notes.notes:
Mercenaries!

Anti-cheat is our major and critical priority. This Dev Letter will go through and talk about what we've been preparing, and how we plan to execute the anti-cheat, as well as what we have planned for the future.

[h3]1. In-game report[/h3]
Automatically detected through our system, cheaters are continuously being banned.
However, mercenaries can help ban the cheaters by using the 'Report Cheater' button on the left-hand bottom when you press the 'ESC' button.
This also helps us verify cheaters more easily!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/17ca9311c8f71c62f9c503fb4882c23cc8405c97.png[/img]
However, some cheaters need to be analyzed, so please understand the occasional delay.
This system is to be improved over time.

[h3]2. Data accumulation[/h3]
We accumulate all user-play data on our system to discern cheaters.
The automatic system analysis/detection is based on user play patterns.
This system is continuously being developed and will give us an advantage for verifying cheaters.

[h3]3. EOS(EAC) [/h3]
EOS (EAC) partial reinforcement and several logs are being analyzed to enhance the functional role of the anti-cheat.

[h3]4. Another way we find cheaters[/h3]
As a lot of people know, A.V.A has been a service for a long time in many versions, 
we have a lot of know-how to determine cheaters. 
After we have more data that has been accumulated, another method of verifying cheaters will be possible.

We have been working diligently to provide all players with an equitable gameplay environment. Many of those who violated the Code of Conduct have received serious consequences; we have already received inquiries from those who violated the Code of Conduct. [u][b]We do not tolerate any forms of unjustified behavior.[/b][/u] Bans will continue to be carried out on a daily basis. 

We will continue to listen and take action to ensure a fair and safe gameplay environment.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Operations Team

notes.title: Differences Between Camp and Clan
notes.notes:
Mercenaries!

We have received a lot of questions about the differences between Camps and Clans
so here is some info on the differences between the two.

[b][h3]Camps[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Once you enter a Camp, [b][u]you may not leave the camp[/u][/b] until you have joined a clan.
[*] Camps are public and users within the camp will be able to talk to each other.
[*] Playing as a squad in a camp, the camp does not receive 'Clan RP'.
[*] You may join a camp without approval.
[/list]

[b][h3]Clans[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Once you enter a Clan, you automatically leave the camp.
[*] Clans have 'Clan master' and 'Staff' who manage the Clan.
[*] Clans may receive 'Clan RP' when playing.
[*] Joining a Clan will need the 'Clan master' or 'Staff' approval.
[*] Clan emblems (badge) are managed by the 'Clan master'.
[/list]

We hope this info helps!

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Operations Team

notes.title: AVA Global Code of Conduct
notes.notes:
[h1]Code of Conduct[/h1]
[i]We ask everyone to practice good human decency and respect for other players.
[/i]

[b]Responsibility[/b]
You are responsible for how you interact within Alliance of Valiant Arms Global (A.V.A Global / AVA). Neowiz and its agents can not be held responsible for actions or comments made be users anywhere. Noewiz reservers the rights to take action upon any content published by a user.

[b]Communication[/b]
You are responsible for how you may express yourself. Rude, offensive, and inappropriate means of communication shall not be used. Discrimination, threats, sharing personal information, hate speech, misrepresentation of individuals or entities, racism are unacceptable.

[b]Account Security[/b]
You are responsible for the safety of your Steam account. A.V.A Global staff members will never ask for your security credentials.

[b]Cheating[/b]
Cheating will result in action taken. Using third party programs, macro, glitches, modification to software or hardware that provides an unfair advantage, exchange of kills/score/win exchange (farming), account sharing or trading, clan sharing or trading, improper gameplay that affects other players are considered as cheating.

notes.title: AVA Development Log: Removal of Pay 2 Win
notes.notes:
Mercenaries!

Today we would like to take away some confusion that has arisen around the removal of Pay2Win. We have been committed to removing Pay2Win from the start, but after the first CBT and the Battle Pass announcement it has become clear that we left room for interpretation of how we removed it; so we would like to take the time to address this issue properly.

We would like to confirm in writing that the extra bullets for skins, which were in the game during the first CBT Playtest, will be removed in the upcoming build. Additionally, we have taken the step to remove boosts that characters have, so that they won't be Pay2Win either. As an example, this means that Marek R. Reznak will no longer have his 10% walking speed boost.

We want to further reiterate that we are committed to fully remove Pay2Win and understand we fell short in the first CBT. We apologize for this, and we hope that by taking this step we can fix that mistake. In case other concerns regarding Pay2Win pop up, feel free to let us know so we can investigate and act if necessary.

In the coming weeks we hope to share more updates regarding our progress on the CBT Playtest build, so stay on the lookout for more positive news!

Thanks.

Sincerely, 
Your AVA Operations Team

notes.title: A letter from the A.V.A team(3)
notes.notes:
Mercenaries!

After our partner streams, we've had a lot of users ask about the Weapon Modification Ticket system.

So, we will like to give you more information about how the Weapon Modification system works.

To request a modification for your weapon, you must have an item called the Weapon Mod Request Ticket.

When used, the modification points are randomly distributed within 5 points according to the designated modification category of each gun.

This improves the performance of the weapon: Attack(damage), Range, Firing Rate, Accuracy, Reload Speed, Recoil Control, Shot Amount (pellets of Shotguns), Mobility, Swap Speed (Sniper), and/or Aim Speed (Sniper).

Pressing the up arrow next to your weapon allows you to use 1 ticket.

Firearm Mod Request Tickets can be purchased through Euros or Medals through the shop. If you need more tickets you can also obtain them through random boxes that are given out at the end of every match.

The gun modification system is a way for you to customize the performance of your own firearm to fit your gameplay style.

If you press the modification icon and press modify, then you will lose the previous stats that have been applied to your weapon – this cannot be reverted back.

Please note that this is not a system that affects the balance of the game.

[b][Weapon Modification Request Q&A][/b]
Q. How many times can I use Firearm Mod Request?
A. You will be able to use the Firearm Mod Request infinite times but, you will need tickets.

Q. Will the modification points be accumulated every time I use the Firearm Mod Request tickets?
A. No. Firearm Mod Request will only let you gain 5 random points on your weapon. If you use the ticket on your weapon that has already been modified, the weapon will be modified again giving it different stats.

You can check how many tickets you have in your inventory > equipment. 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/195b1bedd56e27cacb2ec4c16e4b64a42c6fc934.png[/img]

[b][Weapon Modification Tutorial][/b]
In your inventory, press the arrow shape displayed on the left side of the weapon.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/9a38b1393c220dbeff03390ac1efe2b704fa54c8.png[/img]

If you press the arrow shape, then this screen will appear. You can modify the item by pressing “Modify.”
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/7579d7d2d5f3e4f9881d1308969751ab53532571.png[/img]

Points will be distributed after weapon modification.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/e6f1ea3f6117675f318bbf8f7071907052fc613a.png[/img]

Improved figures for each stat area are displayed in green.
For example: The Range point blow shows 79.0 as the result of your weapon modification, [u][b]NOT 79+8.[/b][/u]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/1ebe7404a818d47141d4c57a6676d7d42b9f4601.png[/img]
* The images above are examples for understanding purposes. The values applied to each item varies.

We hope this guide is informative!

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Operations Team

notes.title: A letter from the A.V.A team(2)
notes.notes:
To Our Dedicated and Patient Community,

As we prepare for Playtest, we would like to let you know about the upcoming Escort mode!

[b]More Fun[/b]
A.V.A’s Escort mode has been enjoyed by many players. Some of you may also remember the Breach mode being the modern successor of the Escort mode.
We thought a lot about ways to make the Escort mode more suitable for your gameplay experience. We noticed that the entry barrier for Escort mode was quite high, so we changed some of the complicated rules to make the mode more accessible for everyone. This means excluding the most difficult part of this mode to provide a fun experience for everyone!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rWJAVMDyoHQ
[b]Escort or Breach Mode?[/b]
Comparing these 2 exciting modes, Breach mode was created to make Escort mode more enjoyable! We made improvements by easing the tank repair method and regeneration time. 
Escort and Breach modes both concentrated on the attacking and defensive aspects that made the game unique. While escort mode concentrated more on strategic gameplay experience, Breach mode focused on a more casual experience.

[b]What’s Next?[/b]
In the upcoming beta testing (Playtest), we have prepared an environment where you can enjoy both Escort and Breach modes. You can be immersed into the combat environment through audio and visual experience as you fight through the battlefield. We hope you will enjoy both modes and provide valuable feedback!

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Operations Team

notes.title: A letter from the A.V.A team(1)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/f5e3f490187c86b8ff9fc91f2f752025b7ac3656.png[/img]

To Our Dedicated and Patient Community,

To start, we would like to express our gratitude to you – our AVA fans who waited a long time for AVA Global Service. Reading your comments on various social media pages, you must have been curious about how AVA will return. 

While preparing for global service, our development and management teams conducted several data driven research projects based on feedback from existing services and AVA Global social media sites.

We have thought about how to provide a service dedicated to the community and making sure players have a much more enjoyable gameplay environment. 

This means: 
1)	Listen to the community
2)	Act for the community

“What Are We Thinking?”

The factors related to weapons has seen the most feedback and interest from the players in existing service regions and social media pages.

In our existing service regions, many fans requested for improvements of weapons (weapons with reasonably better stats) and items.

This subject has become one of the several highest priorities for our team. After a lot of data driven research, we have found a more stable solution for our Global players!

“P2W Affecting Player’s Gameplay Experience:”

Balancing the performance of numerous items is one of the community’s biggest concerns as well as how players will be able to obtain them. Standing with the community, this is one of our biggest concerns too.

In fact, various opinions and dissatisfaction about item balancing are still an issue in most shooter genre games – we want to address this accordingly.

With the existing versions of A.V.A in various regions, there are some users who want balanced items for a better gameplay experience. This has led to different user preferences. To be specific, the reasons are linked to cash items becoming “P2W.”

Many users have raised concerns regarding this type of system that has brough negative experiences to the game.

In early 2021, our team started to find a modern and data driven solution to have this totally changed. We believe that the community’s satisfaction is important.

“New Ideas:”

We have made bold decisions! We have balanced the performance of each item groups from “performance” to “visual.”

This means fascinating weapon bodies, shiny gun barrel, and beautiful charismatic item designs.

We hope you show interests and response to the skinned items.

In addition, premium valued items are no longer only obtainable through financial incentives. We have found a solution that can be used to acquire items in various ways such as experiences and in-game currency.

Further, various items now utilize the “weapon modification” options to create a performance that suits your gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/ee389fe998a915ca152f600bc9c1af36e3bbca12.jpg[/img]
For now, we will focus on item design and responsible performance. We want to create a welcoming environment for everyone.

The rise of classic and authentic A.V.A is at your fingertips!

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Operations Team

notes.title: Announcement regarding A.V.A release date
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/4d74fb27c7c85a4961630368f408f8c2a6ba7269.jpg[/img]

To Our Dedicated and Patient Community,

We would like to share an important update from our event regarding the game launch. We have considered feedback from players within the community and we have made the difficult decision to delay the launch of the game to better prepare the build for the global market.

The game currently is a bit old and necessary changes need to be made in order to fit within the global standards. This includes, but is not limited to; balancing, bug fixes, and stability.

During the internal testing of the game, we’ve found stability and balance concerns that cannot be ignored. We have decided that we need to make the necessary changes to fit the global standards for a top-tier online shooter. We apologize for this unwelcome news, just as we hope to deliver an enjoyable game for everyone. 

We understand that this news is devastating to the many of you who have been waiting so long for AVA’s return to Steam, but we hope that you can understand why this decision was made. We want to ensure that the version of AVA we deliver is as good as can be, so that the game can last for a long time into the future. 

We apologize for the inconvenience this news may cause, and look forward to working with everyone to make the return of AVA as glorious as possible.

Thank you all for your enduring support and ceaseless understanding.

Sincerely,
Your A.V.A Team
